landing.headline: See the outbreak before it spreads.
landing.sub: Report a sick animal in your own language in under two minutes — get instant, explainable triage while district officers watch the live risk map.
landing.disclaimer: Preliminary triage, not a diagnosis — always consult a veterinarian.
landing.feat1b: Reports save on your phone and sync when the signal returns.
landing.feat2b: English, हिंदी and मराठी — farmer-first, voice-friendly.
landing.feat3b: Every AI result shows which symptoms matched and why.

auth.loginSub: Sign in to your PashuSetu account.
auth.signupSub: Join as a farmer, field worker or official.
auth.name: Full name
auth.confirmEmail: Account created. Check your email to confirm, then sign in.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

dashboard.heroLine: One report today can protect a whole herd tomorrow.

report.heading: Report
report.lede: Report a sick or dead animal in under two minutes — works offline too.
report.emptyBody: Species → Symptoms → Counts → Location → Submit. Coming in Part 1.
report.photoHint: A clear photo of the affected area helps triage. A photo is never required.
report.photoError: Could not read that photo. Try another.
report.gpsError: Could not get GPS — please fill in the village details.
report.doneSyncedBody: Your report has been received — the triage result appears below.
report.doneQueuedBody: No connection right now — your report is safely stored on this phone and will sync automatically when you are back online.

cases.heading: Command centre
cases.lede: Live reports across {district} — verify each case to confirm or reject the field signal.
cases.mapHint: Pin colour = urgency · glow = animals affected
cases.mapEmpty: No geo-tagged reports yet — pins appear as farmers allow GPS.
cases.queueHint: Newest first — new reports appear automatically
cases.emptyBody: Reports from your district appear here the moment farmers submit them.
cases.decideError: Could not save the decision — please try again.
cases.flywheelNote: Every confirm or reject is stored as a labelled example — your decisions quietly train the next version of the triage engine.

herd.heading: Herd
herd.emptyBody: Animal cards, vaccination list and coverage rings go here. Coming in Part 1.
herd.tagInvalid: Tag ID must be exactly 12 digits.
herd.emptyBodyOwn: Add your animals to link them in reports and track vaccinations.

triage.heading: Triage
triage.lede: Rule-based assessment shown transparently — always preliminary, never a diagnosis.
triage.emptyBody: Suspected condition, confidence, reasons, first-aid advisory and next actions. Coming in Part 2.
triage.disclaimer: Preliminary triage, not a diagnosis — always consult a veterinarian.
triage.noCandidates: The signs did not clearly match a known disease — a veterinarian should examine the animal.
triage.emptyNow: Submit a report and its triage result will appear here.

reasons.symptom_match: {matched} of {total} known signs of this disease match
reasons.season: This disease is in season right now
reasons.nearby: {count, plural, one {# similar report} other {# similar reports}} in your district in the last 14 days
reasons.zoonotic: Can spread to humans — handle with care
reasons.notifiable: Notifiable disease — authorities must be informed

triage.matchNote: The reported signs match {matched} of {total} key indicators for this disease.
triage.confNote: Confidence indicates how well the reported signs match this disease.
triage.actionNote: Quick action can prevent spread and protect the herd.
triage.analysisSub: Reasoning, sign match details and other possibilities.
triage.pendingHint: This may take a few seconds.
triage.urgencyNote: Urgency reflects how dangerous the suspected disease is and whether deaths were reported — not only the confidence score.

alerts.heading: Alerts
alerts.lede: Outbreak warnings, field-verify flags and vaccination reminders for your area.
alerts.emptyBody: Cluster and early-warning alerts for your village will appear here. Coming in Part 5.
